title: HoverCard
wrapsNative: MonarchPopover (androidx.compose.ui.window.Popup) anchored to a MonarchLink in a androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box, holding MonarchAvatar, MonarchText and MonarchButton
summary: A recipe, not a component: a preview card for a link, such as a person or a document, opened by a tap on the link in MonarchPopover, with the details and an action.
whenToUse: When a name or a reference in a list or a sentence has details worth a glance without leaving the screen: a person's role, a document's owner and date.
whenNotToUse: When the details are the destination, open the screen instead. For a one-line explanation, use a tooltip. For actions on the item, use a dropdown or context menu.
api: @Composable fun MonarchPopover(expanded: Boolean, onDismissRequest: () -> Unit, label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, side: MonarchPopoverSide = MonarchPopoverSide.Bottom, content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)
@Composable fun MonarchLink(text: String, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchLinkVariant = MonarchLinkVariant.Inline, …)
@Composable fun MonarchAvatar(image: Painter?, name: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, …, size: MonarchAvatarSize = MonarchAvatarSize.Md, …, decorative: Boolean = false, …)

states.name: open
states.description: A tap opens the card under the link (or above it with MonarchPopoverSide.Top), on the raised surface.

states.name: dismissed
states.description: A tap outside or back closes it.

appearance: MonarchPopover's raised surface with the default border and shadow, holding a large avatar, the name in the strong body style, a detail line in the muted text color and a small button. The same roles in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web HoverCard opens after a delay on pointer hover or keyboard focus and closes when both leave. Touch has no hover, so on Android a tap on the link opens the same content in MonarchPopover, and the link's own destination moves into the card as a button ("View profile"). If the link must keep its tap for navigation, open the card from a long press with Modifier.combinedClickable instead and say so in the link's onLongClickLabel. There is no open or close delay. iOS uses the touch-and-hold context menu with a preview.
accessibility: The link has a 48dp touch target; TalkBack reads it as a link to activate.
MonarchPopover is named by its label and closes with back; TalkBack moves into it when it opens.
The avatar is decorative because the name is in the card as text.
The action in the card is a MonarchButton with a 48dp touch target.
edgeCases: Near the bottom of the screen, use MonarchPopoverSide.Top so the card has room.
Do not put a hover card inside another popover.
